Alternate Forms
Counterfeit FormArtisan Form
Poltchageist has a unique special form only available rarely in the wild. The standard forms are considered forgeries but very rarely a real one can be found. The form has no stat or level differences but changes evolution method. The only visible difference is that it has an authenticity stamp on the underside. The Artisan Form does not breed down, any Artisan Form parents produce Counterfeit Form offspring
